title: Bitcoin Movie Enigma

prize.note: single P2WPKH escrow, one funding transaction

target_format: BIP39 24 words (English), most likely BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/i (script type v0_p2wpkh), no passphrase stated

derivation.summary: identify the 34 movies shown in panel order, transform each title into an English BIP39 word, drop 10 'intruder' words identified from an IMDb metadata field, and derive the resulting 24-word mnemonic to a P2WPKH address
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39/BIP84 test vectors (12-word and 24-word 'abandon' vectors), since no solved sibling exists for this puzzle

difficulty_note: the derivation is bounded and fast once the inputs are known; all 34 films now have an identification (community list checked against the stills by AppleLamps on 2026-08-27, panel 14 settled by a frame match on 2026-09-03). A unique BIP39 4-letter prefix scan of each compact title yields a word for 33 of 34 titles; only The Goonies has none. The remaining gate is that Goonies word plus the IMDb field that drops 10 of the 34 words; three fields split the list exactly (Kubrick x5 plus Jean Reno x5, year 2000 or later, year before 1980), and 12 sweeps of the mechanical readings of both rules on the consensus list (1.7e10 raw candidates, 69 million derivations, 5 of 12 runs witnessed) are negative

leads.title: find the title-to-word rule for The Goonies
Kubrick x5 plus Jean Reno x5 as the intruders, two free positions (panels 8 and 26, or 8 and 32)
find the IMDb field that splits 24 keepers from 10 intruders
regional IMDb titles and AKAs for The Goonies, Sharknado and Raiders (issue #9, couldes)
re-check panels 9, 13 and 24 against the issue #9 sources
